I am trying to calibrate a small watershed inside my basin, but I keep get this error:
[SPS-ERROR] 2024-10-26 09:22:50.540346 task 5 failed - "no lines available in input"

[SPS-ERROR] 2024-10-26 09:28:53.352893 task 15 failed - "no lines available in input" [SPS-ERROR] 2024-10-26 09:33:16.848463 task 7 failed - "no lines available in input"

Please note that I already calibrated other watersheds and all of them worked except that watershed.
I already made sure that I set the calibration.cal in the file.co file, also, it's "y" in the print.pre file.

Something to mention that I have missing data in the observed data file, but I already filled it up with NAN.

Also, something strange happen in this watershed, that when I run it for 1 to 10 iterations, it works and it gives me results, but more than this I get that error I mentioned before. Thank you,
Hesham
